title: antarctic-ice-shelf-utac — P120: real Antarctic ice shelf mass loss, mechanism, and regional asymmetry
description: Real Antarctic ice shelf mass budget (71 of 162 shelves lost mass 1997-2021, 8.3 trillion tonnes total, DOI 10.1126/sciadv.adi0186), a real Holocene meltwater-release feedback mechanism (Nature Geoscience 2025), and a real sign-flipped regional asymmetry under CMIP6 projections -- East Antarctica's feedback amplifies warming, West Antarctica's Amundsen/Bellingshausen sectors show cooling/suppressed warming (Muilwijk et al. 2026, The Cryosphere, DOI 10.5194/tc-20-1087-2026). Deliberately no UTAC/CREP/AFET bridge and no invented Gamma value -- see DISCLAIMER.md. Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem (P120, domain: climate / cryosphere).
